import types
from test.support import run_code, check_syntax_error, import_helper, cpython_only

def build_module(code: str, name: str='top') -> types.ModuleType:
    ns = run_code(code)
    mod = types.ModuleType(name)
    mod.__dict__.update(ns)
    return mod

def _t():
    ns = run_code('class X: (y): int')
    assert ns['X'].__annotations__ == {}, ('assertEqual', ns['X'].__annotations__, {})
    ns = run_code('class X: int.b: int')
    assert ns['X'].__annotations__ == {}, ('assertEqual', ns['X'].__annotations__, {})
    ns = run_code('class X: int[str]: int')
    assert ns['X'].__annotations__ == {}, ('assertEqual', ns['X'].__annotations__, {})
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import annotationlib
import types
from test.support import run_code, check_syntax_error, import_helper, cpython_only

def build_module(code: str, name: str='top') -> types.ModuleType:
    ns = run_code(code)
    mod = types.ModuleType(name)
    mod.__dict__.update(ns)
    return mod

def _t():
    code = '\n        from __future__ import annotations\n\n        def f(x: int) -> int: pass\n        '
    ns = run_code(code)
    f = ns['f']
    assert isinstance(f.__annotate__, types.FunctionType), ('assertIsInstance', f.__annotate__, types.FunctionType)
    annos = {'x': 'int', 'return': 'int'}
    assert f.__annotate__(annotationlib.Format.VALUE) == annos, ('assertEqual', f.__annotate__(annotationlib.Format.VALUE), annos)
    assert f.__annotations__ == annos, ('assertEqual', f.__annotations__, annos)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import re as _re
import types
from test.support import run_code, check_syntax_error, import_helper, cpython_only

def build_module(code: str, name: str='top') -> types.ModuleType:
    ns = run_code(code)
    mod = types.ModuleType(name)
    mod.__dict__.update(ns)
    return mod

def _t():
    code = '\n        class format: pass\n\n        def f(x: format): pass\n        '
    ns = run_code(code)
    f = ns['f']
    assert f.__annotations__ == {'x': ns['format']}, ('assertEqual', f.__annotations__, {'x': ns['format']})
    code = '\n        class Outer:\n            class format: pass\n\n            def meth(self, x: format): ...\n        '
    ns = run_code(code)
    assert ns['Outer'].meth.__annotations__ == {'x': ns['Outer'].format}, ('assertEqual', ns['Outer'].meth.__annotations__, {'x': ns['Outer'].format})
    code = '\n        def f(format):\n            def inner(x: format): pass\n            return inner\n        res = f("closure var")\n        '
    ns = run_code(code)
    assert ns['res'].__annotations__ == {'x': 'closure var'}, ('assertEqual', ns['res'].__annotations__, {'x': 'closure var'})
    code = '\n        def f(x: format):\n            pass\n        '
    ns = run_code(code)
    assert ns['f'].__annotations__ == {'x': format}, ('assertEqual', ns['f'].__annotations__, {'x': format})
    code = '\n        def outer():\n            def f(x: format):\n                pass\n            if False:\n                class format: pass\n            return f\n        f = outer()\n        '
    ns = run_code(code)
    try:
        ns['f'].__annotations__
    except NameError as _exc:
        assert _re.search("cannot access free variable 'format' where it is not associated with a value in enclosing scope", str(_exc)), 'assertRaisesRegex: message mismatch'
    else:
        raise AssertionError('assertRaises: did not raise')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import types
from test.support import run_code, check_syntax_error, import_helper, cpython_only

def _t():
    code = '\n            unique_name_1 = unique_name_5 = [1]\n            name_0 = 42\n            unique_name_7: {name_0 for name_0 in unique_name_1}\n            unique_name_2: {\n                0: (lambda: name_0 for unique_name_4 in unique_name_5)\n                for unique_name_6 in [1]\n                if name_0\n            }\n        '
    mod = build_module(code)
    annos = mod.__annotations__
    assert annos.keys() == {'unique_name_7', 'unique_name_2'}, ('assertEqual', annos.keys(), {'unique_name_7', 'unique_name_2'})
    assert annos['unique_name_7'] == {True}, ('assertEqual', annos['unique_name_7'], {True})
    genexp = annos['unique_name_2'][0]
    lamb = list(genexp)[0]
    assert lamb() == 42, ('assertEqual', lamb(), 42)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import types
from test.support import run_code, check_syntax_error, import_helper, cpython_only

def build_module(code: str, name: str='top') -> types.ModuleType:

    code = '\n        def f() -> None:\n            def nested() -> None: pass\n            return nested\n        class Outer:\n            x: int\n            def method(self, x: int):\n                pass\n        '
    ns = run_code(code)
    method = ns['Outer'].method
    assert ns['f'].__annotate__.__qualname__ == 'f.__annotate__', ('assertEqual', ns['f'].__annotate__.__qualname__, 'f.__annotate__')
    assert ns['f']().__annotate__.__qualname__ == 'f.<locals>.nested.__annotate__', ('assertEqual', ns['f']().__annotate__.__qualname__, 'f.<locals>.nested.__annotate__')
    assert method.__annotate__.__qualname__ == 'Outer.method.__annotate__', ('assertEqual', method.__annotate__.__qualname__, 'Outer.method.__annotate__')
    assert ns['Outer'].__annotate__.__qualname__ == 'Outer.__annotate__', ('assertEqual', ns['Outer'].__annotate__.__qualname__, 'Outer.__annotate__')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
